[P1] Honor deadline termination on handler-error exits

If the handler rejects while a child-context checkpoint is pending, and the deadline expires while the outer `catch` drains that checkpoint, this check never runs. The catch returns `FAILED` and reports `FAILED` to plugins instead of throwing `InvocationDeadlineError`, turning the intended retryable deadline outcome into an execution-failure response. Apply the termination-aware outcome logic to the error exit too, preserving revoked-token precedence, and add a regression with a rejecting handler and a checkpoint held across the deadline.
